notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/b0eaf274634fd6a965b483acec3252361d3a167c.png[/img]

Hello Martians!

Great news! We're excited to announce that we've just published an FAQ for our game Mars Colony Builder on Steam. This material provides answers to many frequently asked questions, which should help you better understand our game. 

[b]1. When will Mars Colony Builder be released?[/b]
Unfortunately, at this stage of the development of the game, we can’t determine it, but we can assure you that we’re doing our best to make it happen as soon as possible. Stay tuned!

[b]2. Do you know how much the game will cost?[/b]
At this point, the price of the game isn’t yet known, we’ll be able to give a more specific amount directly before the game is released, in consultation with our publisher.

[b]3. Will there be beta tests?[/b]
We hope so. At the moment, we can't give too many details about it, but we’ll definitely want to give players the opportunity to check out what the gameplay looks like and learn about the basic mechanics of the game, but we’ll keep you updated on everything.

[b]4. Do you plan to release a demo or prologue?[/b]
Yes, we have plans for a demo or prologue, but unfortunately, we can't disclose any details at this time. We can say that we’re very excited and can't wait to show what we've prepared for our community.

[b]5. What engine is the game developed on?[/b]
The game is developed on Unreal Engine 5.0.

[b]6. Where can I find more information about the game?[/b]
More information can be found on our Steam, Discord, and other social media. Follow us on a regular basis so as not to miss any important information.

[b]7. What platforms will the game be available on?[/b]
At the moment, we plan to release the game on the Steam platform, in the PC version. Who knows, maybe there will be some other versions in the future, we don’t rule anything out.

[b]8. Why are you making a game about colonizing Mars?[/b]
Well… We’re making a game about colonizing Mars because it’s an exciting and challenging topic that allows players to explore the possibilities of space exploration and the future of humanity. The game will allow players to experience the challenges and rewards of building a colony on Mars and will also educate them about the scientific and technological aspects of space travel. The game isn’t only a fun.

[b]9. What mode will be in the game? Singleplayer or multiplayer?[/b]
At this point, we plan to release the game only with a singleplayer mode.

Of course, if you have any additional inquiries or need assistance, please feel free to reach out to us directly. Thank you for your interest in our game, [url=https://discord.gg/jxcFsTw][b]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/b][/url] and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Redesign. Join our Discord!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/6394a6aa1e1267133a325836b9fc28b04928c0ee.png[/img]

Hello, Martians!

We've been working hard on our game while we were away!

In order to provide you with the highest quality game, we have made the difficult decision to redesign our buildings and transfer the project to Unreal Engine 5!

Quality is the most important thing for us, so we decided to focus on the latest technology in response to the changing trends in the gaming industry.

Just look at the quality of our habitats where the first mars colonizers live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/76ad304cd73b7d17fde789c97d65f853bb3e0e32.jpg[/img]

In addition to the redesign and technology upgrade, we'll also be adding more new content to the game, and we'll be more active in sharing our progress with the community. We encourage you to add our game to your Wishlist on Steam and stay updated on our development. Also, join our Discord where you can stay in touch with us and other players and share your opinions. We're excited to share our new and improved game with you and can't wait for you to experience it!

[url=https://discord.gg/jxcFsTw][b]JOIN OUR DISCORD![/b][/url]

See you soon and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Atmospheric Processor
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/b81f7984ac4e67ff025b34ad4baa06da5177108c.png[/img]

Hello Martians!

We haven't been here for a long time, but we can assure you that during this time we weren't idle, but were developing our project called Mars Colony Builder.

We spent the last time on refining buildings and other objects that will be in the colony on the Red Planet. You could already see a few of them in earlier news on Steam and as concepts on social media, today we come to you with another building, which is the [b]Atmospheric Processor[/b] - a huge object used for "terraformation", the creation of a favorable atmosphere for man on planets or moons. Below are some screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/5125e7a88660626768bef87315cc0439e594ae6e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/90a2902e7236dac6dc03b2ba098bf1bc8eae2214.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/8a20468fef36ee4cea8f357b3bcaa4dafec18035.png[/img]

What do you think of this material? We look forward to your feedback!

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Regolith Processing Plant
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/e1433cb8f970ad52cd030f7cf4da3fbe0d2ba56f.png[/img]

Hello Colonists!

We continue work on our colonization of the Red Planet called Mars Colony Builder!

As you well know, currently in our work we're focusing on creating new objects that can be found in our game. You've had the opportunity to meet, among others, Recreation Center or Earth Plantation. Today we want to show you the [b]Regolith Processing Plant[/b]. This will be the place where regolith will be processed. As a reminder, regolith is the weathered and chipped upper layer of rock on Mars.

Below we present the screenshots of this building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/602318a7d8496f85fe3f88f7ac0ed4ec8059c7bd.png[/img]

Hello Martians!

We come back to you with another material, in which we'll show you another interesting object that will be in our game Mars Colony Builder.

We'd like to show you the [b]Aurora Borealis Generator[/b]. Recently, the art concept of this object appeared on our social media - by the way, we encourage you to join them, you can find the link [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1403850/discussions/0/2966145784741568045/]HERE[/url][/b] - and you really like it. So... today we come to you with screenshot of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/bfb5b1b04dcd7a04a500553123324e8ea3bf4e40.png[/img]

The player can build it as an ornament of his colony and - as the name suggests - will generate "mini" auroras.

Let us know how do you like it and stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: Residential Habitat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/1009b1c6f8b2c6a4308ccd03904d0db111416fbd.png[/img]

Hello Colonists!

We're grateful for such a positive reception of the materials we publish on Steam and our social media. Your messages, likes and comments give us a lot of motivation to keep working and making Mars Colony Builder as good as possible. Thanks a lot for that!

Now let's move on to the main topic. Today we come to you with a post in which we'll show you another building that will be in our game. This time it will be [b]Residential Habitat[/b]. It’s an object that will have a residential function in the colony. Below are some screenshots of what it will look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/e9e64bb0c6f27376ed9b1aa7ba85c591668f2251.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/16e99bb8ae1379baa2b2114b033cb0b9dc7436cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/50e790fc76875f5ceab77e203e9e820eda15421a.png[/img]

What do you think about him? Do you like it or maybe you would change something? Let us know, any feedback is appreciated!

We also remind you about previous devlogs, in which you could find out what our other buildings look like - Command Center and Recreation Center. If you haven't seen these materials yet, check them out!

Stay tuned with us and see you soon!

notes.title: Martians, Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978464/ad9f5c1bcc7cbbeea6f2284aced270770a3dd8c3.png[/img]

Hello, Martians!

Will the inhabitants of Mars in their colony celebrate Christmas? We don't know ... Will they celebrate the New Year as they do on Earth? Perhaps, but we don't know when, because time flows differently there.

However... for now, we're still on Earth, where we'll soon have Christmas and the coming of the New Year, therefore...

Our Communities, we'd like to extend our [b]best wishes to you![/b] Health, happiness and all good fortune, "cosmic” entry into the New Year!

Game Hunters Studio
